title: Palak Paneer Bhurji
tagline: Soft scrambled paneer folded through garlicky spinach. Dinner in twenty minutes, no shopping trip.

substitutes.name: Firm tofu
substitutes.note: Press for 10 min, crumble, and add a squeeze of lemon at the end.

substitutes.name: Eggs
substitutes.note: Use 3 eggs and scramble them in at step 5 instead (no longer vegetarian).

substitutes.name: Methi leaves
substitutes.note: Use half the amount; methi is more bitter.

substitutes.name: Spring onion
substitutes.note: Use 3 stalks; add the greens at the end.

substitutes.name: Hing
substitutes.note: A pinch in hot oil gives a similar savoury depth.

steps.text: Heat the oil in a kadai on medium heat. Add the cumin seeds and let them crackle.
Add the onion and green chilli. Sauté until the onion turns soft and golden, about 4 minutes.
Stir in the garlic for 30 seconds, then add the tomato, turmeric and a pinch of salt. Cook until the tomato breaks down, about 3 minutes.
steps.tip: Mash the tomato with the back of your spoon to speed it up.

steps.text: Add the chopped spinach. Stir until it wilts and most of the water evaporates, about 4 minutes.
Fold in the crumbled paneer and cook for 2 minutes, just until warmed through. Taste and adjust salt.
steps.tip: Don't overcook the paneer or it turns rubbery.

steps.text: Serve hot with rotis or toasted bread.

tips: Squeeze the chopped spinach lightly before cooking for a drier bhurji.
A pinch of garam masala at the end makes it smell like a dhaba.
